newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end higher after volatile session.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end higher after volatile session.

text.p: Tokyo stocks closed moderately higher on Friday after a volatile session, with the key market index rising 0.61 percent.
But brokers said the market, which had fallen sharply on Thursday, was still basically on a downward trend due to disappointment at the government's handling of the economy.

The benchmark Nikkei 225 average closed 119.79 points or 0.61 percent higher at 19,690.46 after see-sawing in positive and negative territory towards the close. But its March futures lost 70 points to close at 19,590.
Share prices were buoyed by the Wall Street rally overnight, brokers said.

Tokyo stocks tumbled to their lowest level in a year on Thursday, battered by deepening gloom about Japan's economic outlook, with the Nikkei slipping a steep 2.6 percent, its third biggest drop this year.
